blocks.text: A home can be more than the space inside its walls. For some homebuyers, it is also about having room to slow down, spend time outdoors and enjoy everyday conveniences without going far from home. That is the lifestyle behind Sanremo Oasis Cebu, a resort-inspired condominium community within City di Mare at Cebu’s South Road Properties (SRP). Now, Filinvest Land is giving prospective homeowners another way to explore that lifestyle through its #KayaSulit Home Deals, with payment options available for selected studio and two-bedroom units.
